title: Complexes of modules over hierarchical groups
summary: Let $\overline{\mathfrak{F}}$ be the group class obtained from the class $\mathfrak{F}$ of finite groups by iterated applications of Kropholler's operation ${\scriptstyle{\bf LH}}$ and Talelli's operation $Φ$. We describe the structure of the cokenels of acyclic complexes of projective modules over the group algebra of $\overline{\mathfrak{F}}$-groups with coefficients in a commutative ring.
